# E-DISPATCH-PERFECT-001 — Perfecting Agent Dispatch

- **Epic label and number:** E-DISPATCH-PERFECT-001
- **Title:** Perfecting Agent Dispatch
- **Owner:** President Agent
- **Parent roadmap area:** [ROADMAP.md - Epics](../../ROADMAP.md)
- **Goal:** Make the WarpOS agent-dispatch system correct end-to-end: the right model+provider+effort for every role, genuine cross-provider review, product-agnostic + canon-parameterized agents, a simplified (verified) dispatch hierarchy, and machine enforcement for all of it -- built on this session's RE-VERIFIED premises, not inherited ones.
- **Background:** This session re-verified the dispatch foundations and found: (1) the Opus-4.8-max model chain is already complete + enforced (model-chain exit 0, role-parity clean, 35 spec pins) -- foundation, no rebuild; (2) ED-041 ('in-process roster is alpha-only / Agent-not-available-inside-subagents') is FALSIFIED on the current harness via live probe (teammate-epsilon spawned a director, a lead, and a depth-3 nest cleanly; the only block was the WarpOS scope-contract-guard policy gate); (3) many silent-death 'reaps' are legitimate LONG tasks exceeding the harness time budget, which Agent-tool spawns bypass (5/5 alive vs 0/4 CLI). The DISPATCH-ERRORS.md census (40 incidents / 8 weeks, families A-H + redesigns R1-R7) is the evidence base. Operator direction: more gruntwork on codex, smartest-orchestrate / different-provider-review / dumber-doers, 3-provider security review, GPT for the product-leadership chain, fix model-catalog freshness, and genericize agents off the jobzooka origin product. Plan artifact: [../../_planning/epics/E-DISPATCH-PERFECT-001.md](../../_planning/epics/E-DISPATCH-PERFECT-001.md).
- **Scope:** Model/provider/effort routing across the full roster (catalog.js + role-registry.json + dispatch-contract.json + spec frontmatter + the model-router panel); the model-catalog freshness mechanism; the 3-provider security review (declared + FIRED + enforced); the GPT product-leadership chain + the director class-derivation rule; the codex-doer build shape; product-agnostic + canon-parameterized agent genericization + a widened framework-purity enforcer; and the (now-small) dispatch-hierarchy simplification post-ED-041. Re-verification of the DISPATCH-ERRORS.md load-bearing premises (verify-don't-inherit).
- **Out of scope:** Rebuilding the already-complete Opus-4.8-max chain; the full E-DISPATCH-SHAPE-001 ADR-0013 enforce-flip repair (its own epic -- a W3 dependency, not duplicated here); per-product canon authoring (each product supplies its own canon); a full model-router PANEL visual overhaul beyond registry-derived-rows + scrapped-role cleanup.
- **Current state:** Planned
- **Percent completion:** 0% — conservative; plan authored this session on re-verified premises, no sprints landed yet.

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Model-catalog freshness is HONEST: check.js flags stale snapshots at a tightened threshold + always surfaces snapshot age; gpt-5.3-codex removed from catalog + cache + the route.md example; a regression test covers stale + deprecated-id cases.
- [ ] Security review really runs all 3 providers (Gemini-3.1-pro + GPT-5.5 + Claude-opus-4-8): the registry declares the third pass, the enforcers (model-chain + role-parity) validate it, the reviewer protocol + security-lead FIRE all three (not prose-only), and a NAMED enforcer (or logged enforcement-debt) verifies the pass count.
- [ ] The GPT product-leadership chain (director-of-product, product-lead, design-lead, director-of-growth) routes correctly via the cross_provider_consult_lead class, with the new director class-derivation rule landed and fallback:claude on every GPT judgment role; role-parity + model-chain green; a GPT director actually dispatches via subprocess-cross-provider (not the manager/in-process shape).
- [ ] ED-058 model-chain enforcer covers the frontmatter-effort dimension + flags scrapped roles; the 3 stale frontmatter effort pins are corrected (beta xhigh, gamma/delta high); the model-router panel shows registry-derived rows with the 6 scrapped roles removed.
- [ ] The codex-doer build shape exists (subprocess-codex with worktree isolation + reap-safety + completion records) and doers/fixers/skeleton route to gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.4-mini, with security-builder/fixer staying Claude and the coupled reviewer rebalance applied -- gated behind the E-DISPATCH-SHAPE-001 ADR-0013 repair.
- [ ] The agent fleet is product-agnostic: jobzooka domain vocabulary is swept from the contaminated specs, product-specific checks are parameterized from each product's canon, and framework-purity catches domain vocabulary (not just the literal token).
- [ ] The dispatch hierarchy is simplified: ED-041 is retired by ADR, epsilon summons the in-process roster directly (supplying scopeContract), and the spawn-hand-stays-with-the-conductor invariant is documented + enforced (no deep cascade).
- [ ] Every change ships with a planted-violation fixture + mutation check, and every new enforcer is registered as a standing regression class (no hollow ladders).

## Related definitions
- scope-contract-guard -- the WarpOS PreToolUse gate requiring roster/build-chain Agent-tool spawns to carry a scopeContract (or allowed/forbiddenFiles); the ONLY real block surfaced when teammate-epsilon spawns the roster.
- cross_provider_consult_lead -- the dispatch-contract class for a cross-provider (non-Claude) advisory/authoring lead (subprocess-cross-provider, binding_verdict:false); the route the GPT product chain uses.
- ED-041 -- falsified 2026-06-17; the now-retired 'Agent-not-available-inside-subagents / in-process-roster-alpha-only' premise.
- subprocess-codex (new) -- a build dispatch shape with worktree-write isolation + reap-safety + completion records, the W3 vehicle for codex doers (distinct from the read-only subprocess-cross-provider shape).

## Dependencies
- W3 (codex-doer) depends on E-DISPATCH-SHAPE-001 (~88%) finishing its ADR-0013 dispatch-contract enforce-flip repair (the -w / fixer / normalized-roles fix) -- building a codex build shape on the mid-revert gate inherits its bugs.
- W2's director-of-product/growth rule + W1 + W5 edit role-registry.json AND dispatch-contract.json (shared keystones, the latter mid-flight with the ADR-0013 revert) -- foreground-serial, sequence carefully.
- W0 (catalog/check + panel) and W4 (agent-spec sweep) are independent of the shared keystones and of each other.

## Blockers
- None hard-blocking the ship-now waves (W0/W1/W2/W5). W3 is blocked on the E-DISPATCH-SHAPE-001 ADR-0013 repair landing.

## Risks
- Adding the registry third_pass key WITHOUT wiring the firing = a declarative lie (the current 2-pass is prose-only, not code-fired). beta's conditions a-d MUST all land together.
- Re-providering the build chain to codex while ADR-0013 is mid-revert compounds an open wound (beta's split verdict) -- keep W3 gated until the repair lands.
- The director class-derivation rule edits a SECURITY-class invariant (build_chain->subprocess-claude is load-bearing). beta must verify; do NOT solo-trust (alpha's solo routing drafts have shipped real bugs).
- ED-041's falsification is proven for general-purpose + director + lead + depth-3, NOT yet for every roster role under load or the Playwright-MCP reviewers cleanly -- re-verify before retiring the contract.
- Codex headless reliability (reaps, two billing surfaces, Windows stdin) is separate from the model choice -- the plan upgrade fixes capacity, not reliability.
- Genericizing the security agents risks dropping a real check if canon-parameterization misses a product's billing/data model -- keep the generic OWASP/injection/secrets personas intact.

## Decisions
- 2026-06-17 — ED-041 FALSIFIED on the current harness (live probe) -- re-opened as verify-don't-inherit; the R1/R7 hierarchy redesign collapses to 'let epsilon summon the roster + scopeContract + ADR'.
- 2026-06-17 — Security review -> 3 providers best-of-each, Claude pass LAST (beta DECIDE 0.88) -- must wire the firing, not just the registry key.
- 2026-06-17 — GPT for the product-leadership chain (operator: 'I like how GPT designs product requirements'); director needs a new class-derivation rule (beta-verify pending).
- 2026-06-17 — Codex-doer migration is a Class-C deferred sub-epic (new build shape); the reviewer-flip is COUPLED to the doer-move; security-builder/fixer stay Claude.
- 2026-06-17 — Doer models floored at gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.4-mini (operator); gpt-5.3-codex removed (superseded in the live OpenAI docs).
- 2026-06-17 — Spawn-hand stays with epsilon; judgment cascades down; no deep cascade (parent-spawn-then-return orphans children).
